4. While making the prayer for bail and suspension of sentence, learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that the appellant has suffered incarceration for 8 years though his prayer for suspension has twice been rejected by Co-ordinate benches of this Court vide orders dated 04-04-2019 and 21-06-2022.
5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the State has opposed the prayer for bail by submitting Patna High Court CR.

APP (DB) No.32 of 2019(8) dt.07-02-2025 that as per provisions contained in Section 374(4) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, the appeal relating to sexual offences is required to be heard within six months and this appeal is of the year 2019 and,
therefore, the appeal filed by the appellant be listed for hearing.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, we are not inclined to suspend his sentence,
presently.
7. The prayer for suspension of sentence is rejected.
Accordingly, I.A. No. 03 of 2023 stands rejected.
8. However, in accordance with the mandate of Section 374(4) of the Cr.P.C., we direct for an early hearing of this case.
9. The Registry is directed to prepare the paper-book and get this case listed for final hearing on 11th April, 2025.
